steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's over, Tomimi.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...N-No it's not!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Nurul, Peta!

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: If you don't want your friends getting hurt...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Don't make me angry, Tomimi!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...I won't stop until you promise you'll stay, Gavial!

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Help me, Doctor!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Doctor, I'm scared... Waaahhh...

options: Don't be scared! I'm going to save you!

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Doctor, please. The girl's pouring her heart out here, it wouldn't kill you to work with her.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: The people here are simple. Honestly, it hurts my non-existent robot heart to cheat them so.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Hey now, Doctor, don't look at me like that.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Relax, I'm a Rhodes Island Operator too. Of course I can handle something like this.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Wow, you two are really selling it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: When did you get free?!

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Hah. Sorry, somebody needs to learn to tie a knot.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Did you know Tomimi was going to do this, Doctor?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: B-B-But how did you know?

options: Well, first of all, there was the way you hesitated when Zumama came up.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh? Hesitated?

options: And then when you panicked at Gavial during the ceremony.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Oh, I gave it to Lancet-2.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Wahhh... That was just for you, Doctor. I don't normally let people put things inside me so easily.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's... a rocket launcher?

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Yep. Found it with Tomimi's tribe.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So that means...

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: You got it. The one who shot us down was this little runt right here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ohhhhh, I'm sorry, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Come here.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whimper)

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You're going over my knee.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, please don't spank me, I know what I did was bad...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Them's the breaks.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Naughty little whelps get tail spankings!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whimper)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Tail spanking, huh? Looks ouchie...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Are you going to do it again?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I won't do it agaaain! Waaahhh...!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Anyway, I think we're pretty much okay now, Doctor.

options: I'm surprised you didn't give her the whatever whirlwind thing.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha, well, it's definitely been a lot.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Doctor, you're not falling asleep on your feet there, are you?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I wouldn't want to hurt little Tomimi, after all. Phew, I'm a little tired myself.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: This big guy... does look a little ugly at first, but the angular, rugged design, this cluttered but effective wiring, it has a special beauty to it when you look close.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Real marriage material, I think.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, Lancet-2, go see if we can still salvage the engine.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: What? Are you telling me the engine's inside this big guy?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sure is. And we blew it up.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Oh, poor engine. Poor big guy.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Mr. Dylan, can you do me a favor?

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Zumama, why are you standing there drooling like that?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? What's up?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That... that...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What what?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That... that moving, talking machine is incredible!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, you mean Lancet-2? She's a friend of ours.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: C-Can I talk to her?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Knock yourself out.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Erm... Hello.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Hi?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are you... a machine?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: My product designation is Raythean Exister-S62 Model six-wheeled operation platform. I belong to Rhodes Island, codename Lancet-2.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Wow!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Yes. I do have a certain level of intelligence. As long as your questions aren't too hard, I should be able to answer them.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Speaking of which, I am a medical operation platform, so my knowledge base is focused on medicine. Do keep that in mind.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Is something wrong?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Can I hug you?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What is she doing? Did a screw come loose?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Isn't it obvious? She's in awe of that machine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Shocked as she was when she first saw a moving city, a machine that moves and talks on its own is even more striking!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: And forget her, I'm just as excited!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, my beautiful young lady, might I have the honor of taking you on a date?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I know the most gorgeous spot in the rainforest. I'll take you there for a lovely afternoon!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Oh, y-you're asking me out?!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: I don't know what to do here. I'm flattered... Doctor, should I accept?

options: I'll never let you take my Lancet-2!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Don't butt in, High Priest, or you can't blame me for what happens to our friendship after all these years.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Honestly, I'm with the Doctor here.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Kinda wanna laugh.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Oh, Doctor, to hear you suddenly come out and say that... My heart isn't ready...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: So Gavial, your people you're with now can create this type of machine?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Err, I'm pretty sure Closure can, yeah.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Okay. I've made a decision.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Does this Rhodes Island place need more hands? I want to join.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I want to go with you, to learn about mechanical technology.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I've thought about leaving to go study in the outside world before, but I never seriously considered it because of the tribe. I think this is a great opportunity.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Th-Then I'm going too!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: If this is how it's going to be, then it's time for plan B... I'm going with Gavial!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, I fight really hard. I can definitely help you, Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Err, Doctor, what should I do here?

options: They can come, but I don't know what might happen.
You made your bed, now lie in it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah. Might as well give them the operator tests.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: C'mon, Doctor, be nice.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doooctooor!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Whatever. At least stick with the Doctor and try to learn something.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, Gavial, do me a favor and tell me what this little squirt is saying.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Kemar?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I have to go with her.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: She says she's going with you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh. Cool. She packs a punch. I bet she'll make a fine operator.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: She said okay.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? Wait a second. So Zumama's going, Tomimi's going, and Kemar's going, what about the tribes?

options: You weren't worried about that when you left the first time.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ahahaha, I was seeing red back then! Couldn't think at all.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're right, though... I can't just abandon my tribe.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, I think you've got nothing to worry about in that department.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: It's no Gavial, but the Big Ugly is still pretty strong.

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: That's for sure. I want to make one too.

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: With the Temple destroyed, let's build machines instead. Whoever makes the most awesome one gets to be Great Chief?

steps.name: Archosauria D
steps.text: Hey, no! Fighting is way better!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Oh, good point. I don't want to give up fighting. What should we do?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: All right, morons. Why not just fight and also build machines?!

steps.name: Group of Archosauria
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: See? Nothing to worry about at all.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: From what I've seen, the common folk are usually quick to adapt, even as the leaders hem and haw about the future.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: What if I told you the first Great Chief was actually a Tiacauh Brave who gave himself the title, prior to whom there was no custom to choose a Great Chief at all?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...High Priest, why did you never tell me that before?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, I never thought it was important. Is it? My point is that people are resilient, they'll go on living even if one of their traditions disappears.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I've always thought of traditions as rituals that bring people together.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: But when that tradition carries on for a few decades, they start to think it's inviolable, it's unbreakable, it has to go on forever.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: But that's nonsense!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: So you tell me you want to blow up the Temple and I'm all in, both hands, both feet, and my tail too!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, no, if my hands and feet are in, my tail has to stay out... right? What if I'm laying down? Let's see!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...I get it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Just how old are you?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: How old? I forget.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: And honestly, these methods you have for keeping track of time mean nothing to me! Whether or not I happen to have forgotten when I was born!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: O...kay. But we still need someone to be the Great Chief.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Hey, I heard Gavial and Zumama were fighting again. Is it already over?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that, Gavial?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Say, Inam, are you interested in being Great Chief at all?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So after going through all that, you got the engine back, performed your emergency repairs, and got on the road back home?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Y-Yeah!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor, I do believe I told you what a precious piece of equipment that aircraft was before you left.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Seeing as the aircraft is still in reparable condition, I won't be too hard on you. But the maintenance costs are coming out of your pay, and Blaze's.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Aww, and mine...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: An elite operator takes elite responsibility.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Agh, fine.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for the three individuals you brought back, since you seem to think they have what it takes to be operators, I'll leave them to the Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Gavial, were you satisfied with your trip back home?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Sure. But even I didn't think it'd go down like that. It was fun.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Honestly, I had a contingency plan in case the Doctor didn't bring you back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Because I figured there was a possibility you'd want to stay there.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Kal'tsit, I thought you knew me better than that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You've never really adapted to life outside your tribe. Every day, you come into conflict with the world, in your own ferocious way.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll put it this way: if someday you asked for a leave of absence, or if you just left, I wouldn't be surprised.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Doctor, maybe I'm not getting this right. Is Kal'tsit saying she cares about me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If there's nothing else, Dr. {@nickname}, you can go.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tch, yeah, this is one of those times the Doctor likes to play dead.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Then I'm gonna go ahead and say you care about me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's our Kal'tsit, even confusing the Doctor.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Kal'tsit, I'm not going anywhere.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I had a reason to leave my tribe. I really did want to practice medicine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Now that's not to say I really thought I could become a doctor, but I'm very happy I made that decision.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: From a modern medical standpoint, we pretty much have no doctors back home. If you get sick, you just let it run its course. Maybe try a few traditional remedies.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If I never left, I wouldn't know what the world is really like.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I wouldn't know how many diseases are preventable or curable, I wouldn't know how people look down on Oripathy. I wouldn't know that saving lives makes me as happy as taking them.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: The world is definitely complicated, and I don't always know what motivates people, or why they fight.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But I'm a doctor now. And my dream is to treat Oripathy.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Is there a better place in this wide world for me to study and practice medicine?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm afraid not.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well how about that. And by the way, you all work a lot harder than I do. What's with you here worrying about me?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Honestly, I think I should be worrying about you, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You didn't pick up my slack while I was away now, did you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Good. I'm gonna give Zumama an Oripathy checkup. You have a nice chat now.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, I'll see what Kemar's up to. Err, I guess I'm calling her Flint now. I'm worried she'll get into a fight, with the language barrier and all...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, Tomimi should be in her general studies class now. You check on her when you're done.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Welcome back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey! What about me?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You had another mission ready to go last week. You're technically very late.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In your eyes, you just went on a nonsensical journey.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But, just like our Gavial, it was a showcase of the lively and diverse world we inhabit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We lose so much to the endless march of time. That which was once a fact of life in the past is now precious to us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We search for the light that slips through the breaks in the crowd and begin to see that as the norm.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope you and your fellow operators learned a lesson from this trip: some things are not too far out of reach.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Kal'tsit, meeting time!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now then, Dr. {@nickname}, you have a lot of work waiting for you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope you got enough rest on your vacation.
